QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Become Our New Casting Manager!
QuestInfo.0: Don't let him give up! Help him find a solution. You might come up with something good if you talk to #b#p1052203##k.
QuestInfo.1: You convinced #p1052203# not to give up on his song, but got roped into becoming Jackpot Entertainment's interim casting director as a consequence.
QuestInfo.2: Hear about the basics of casting from #b#p1052212##k before you leave.

yes.0: It's good to know that such a beautiful song won't be lost to the ages. Are you heading off to start your talent search?

default.0: Before you go, you should also have a chat with my secretary, #b#p1052212##k. She can give you a crash course in casting.
